root.command: IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.DriverLocationPingTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.DriverLocationPingTbl ( PingID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_DriverLocationPingTbl PRIMARY KEY, PersonID INT NOT NULL, Latitude DECIMAL(9,6) NOT NULL, Longitude DECIMAL(9,6) NOT NULL, AccuracyM DECIMAL(8,1) NULL, PingTime DATETIME NOT NULL, ReceivedAt DATETIME NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_DriverLocationPing_ReceivedAt DEFAULT (GETDATE()), Source VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, UserName NVARCHAR(256) NULL ); CREATE INDEX IX_DriverLocationPing_Person ON dbo.DriverLocationPingTbl (PersonID, PingTime DESC) INCLUDE (Latitude, Longitude, AccuracyM, Source); CREATE INDEX IX_DriverLocationPing_Time ON dbo.DriverLocationPingTbl (PingTime); END
